# EY

> > EY is a global professional services firm offering strategy, transactions, audit, tax, and digital transformation services to help organizations shape the future with confidence.

EY provides comprehensive business advisory and professional services across strategy consulting, M&A transactions, corporate finance, and enterprise transformation. The firm leverages AI-powered platforms like Enterprise Reimagined™ and Edge Platforms to deliver value creation for clients across industries.

## Key Topics

- Strategy Consulting
- M&A Advisory
- Corporate Finance
- Digital Transformation
- Enterprise Reimagined™
- EY-Parthenon
- Business Transformation
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- Portfolio Management
- AI-Powered Solutions
- Value Creation
- Corporate Strategy
- Transaction Services
- Restructuring & Turnaround
- Working Capital Advisory
